about.title: Nevada City Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Nevada City sits along the SR-49 and SR-20 corridors, where tools, vehicles, farm equipment, and household products move through daily life for its roughly 3,152 residents. When one of those products fails because of a manufacturing flaw, a design defect, or a missing warning, the resulting injury can upend a household fast, especially in a small Sierra foothills community where medical specialists often mean a drive down the hill. California law gives injured people an important advantage here: strict liability. You generally don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless, only that the product was defective and that the defect caused your harm. We listen to what happened and evaluate whether a product defect claim fits your situation, at no upfront cost to you.

whyChoose.title: Why Nevada City Residents Choose Us

items.title: Strict Liability Can Work in Your Favor
items.desc: Under California law, you often don't need to prove the manufacturer was negligent, just that the product was defective and caused your injury. That can simplify what you need to show compared to other injury claims.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable for a defective product. We can help identify every party connected to how the product reached you.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters
items.desc: Because the defect itself is central to a strict liability claim, keeping the product, packaging, and any related paperwork intact can be important. We can advise you on how to protect that evidence early.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California generally allows product liability claims under strict liability, meaning you typically need to show the product was defective and that it caused your injury, rather than proving carelessness. We can review your specific situation to explain how this applies to you.

items.question: What if I no longer have the product that hurt me?
items.answer: It's still worth talking to us. Evidence like photos, packaging, receipts, or medical records can sometimes support a claim even without the item itself. If you still have the product, though, try to keep it stored safely and unaltered.

items.question: Are product-related injuries common around Nevada City?
items.answer: Nevada City sees a mix of vehicle, equipment, and household product incidents typical of a Sierra foothills community along corridors like SR-49 and SR-20. Whether your injury involved a vehicle part, farm equipment, or a household item, we can help sort out whether a defect played a role.

items.question: Is there a cost to speak with us?
items.answer: No. We offer a free case review, and our team generally works on contingency, meaning we only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no obligation to move forward after you talk with us.
